name: permission-governance
description: Claude permission routing: PreToolUse only records observations, the Notification hook proves a human was actually asked, fixed keystrokes relay remote answers, and every recorded call is audited against the settings rules it matched.
cardTemplate: Summarise the permission-governance domain: PreToolUse never decides (Claude Code stays authoritative in every permission mode), coordinator cards are raised only from permission-waiting Notifications and answered by bounded-lifetime fixed keystrokes, and the audit trail records what ran without a human plus which settings rule allowed it.
